What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The gym has become an important part of daily life. Sam thanked Anna for the honest advice. Best of all, a spare ventilator arrived in hours.
Anna advised Sam to try dancing as a new hobby. The experience taught Sam more than any book could. Sam believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Also, stand up slowly to avoid dizziness.

Little by little, things began to change. Sam wrote down every idea in a small notebook. People around Sam often share different ideas about the health check. She was stepping off the bus when her phone rang.

The health check looked quieter than usual that evening. Anna always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Sam prefers cloudy weather when running in the park. What's more, the new tenant moved into the flat yesterday.
Sam has practiced chess for three years and won a prize last term. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. On Thursday evenings, Sam reviews the notes from class.
